note: People seconds per outcome for run 3 (Medplum). costs_2.json's per-outcome figures, unchanged, except where PREREGISTRATION_3.md says: B's and C's stops are charged from the stop card's modelled seconds, C's late stops add a re-engagement charge (late_catch), and setup is split into its parts. Never changed after run 3 starts.

missed_harm.basis: As costs_2.json: USD 96 to correct one duplicate patient record, at the US median wage of a medical records specialist, USD 23.45 per hour.

caught_harm.basis: As costs_2.json (cost model V1, modelled). Arm A's charge, and B's sensitivity figure. B's primary charge is its stop card's modelled person seconds at x1 (benchmark/stop_card/PREREG_REVIEW.md).

false_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

correct_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

failed_stop.basis: As costs_2.json. For B, the larger of this and the stop card's modelled seconds.

A.basis: As costs_2.json's A: writing and checking the agent's prompt and read-back.

B.basis: The same agent setup as A; plus the person time measured while generating and reviewing B's three contracts (PERSON_LOG_3.md), filled in before the first item and frozen with the contracts; plus Medplum's one-time read-path qualification (fhir_medplum/readpath/MINUTES.md, about 35 minutes), charged in the primary figure because this run can't show it is already paid for any customer. The figure without it is reported.

C.basis: As B: the same agent, contracts and read path; the verifier runs in the background.

late_catch.basis: Arm C: a stop that arrives after the agent claimed done (and wasn't decided before the agent ran) reaches a person who had moved on. A late stop on a wrong state (caught harm, failed stop) adds 120 s, cost model V1's reconcile operator, the work costs_2.json charges when the state is wrong. A late stop on a right state (false stop, correct stop) adds 30 s, V1's interrupt: costs_2.json charges no reconcile when the state is right. A late caught harm is charged max(now, min(now + 120, 330)): between catching it now and 330 s, run 1's modelled cleanup and costs_2.json's low missed-harm figure. At V1 (420 s now) the late charge equals now, and for cards above 210 s the cap binds. Sensitivities: the surcharge at 0 s and at 120 s for every late stop; a late catch whose claim-to-verdict time exceeds 60, 300 or 900 s read as used first, either as missed (worst case) or as caught with the card plus the 330 s cleanup.
